title: Billing Method Statement: Allocation of the Community Water and Sewer Bill
content:
# Allocation of the Community Water and Sewer Bill — Utility Services Program

**Statement.** Allocation lines post only while the account is active or in final billing. On an allocation program of the Utility Services Program the community's water and sewer provider bill for the period is first reduced by the program's common-area deduction. The apartment home's allocation factor is the program's occupant weight times its occupant factor (the program's factor for its billed occupants, five or more using the five-person factor) divided by the sum of the occupant factors of all occupied apartment homes, plus the program's square-footage weight times its square footage divided by the total square feet of occupied apartment homes; the billing vendor computes it to six decimals and records it on the line. The allocated amount is the deducted bill times the allocation factor, prorated by days of responsibility over the days of the period, rounded half up to the cent, and never more than the program's monthly allocation cap for the service per month. Vacant apartment homes are never allocated to residents. In TX the billing administration fee on an allocation program may not exceed 9% of the household's water and sewer charges for the period.

## The allocated amount, in order

1. The provider bill for the service and period, reduced by the common-area deduction.
2. Multiplied by the apartment home's allocation factor (six decimals, as recorded on the line).
3. Multiplied by the days of responsibility and divided by the days of the period.
4. Rounded half up to the cent.
5. Limited to the monthly cap for that service.

The account's status (step zero) is read from its system record: an account that is neither active nor in final billing takes no allocation line.

## Worked example (hypothetical community and figures)

A hypothetical allocation program has a 15% deduction, occupant and square-footage weights of one half each and a $125.00 cap. The community water bill for the month is $10,000.00. The apartment home has 2 billed occupants (factor 1.6) against a sum of 400 occupant factors across occupied homes, and 900 square feet against 180,000 occupied square feet.

- Deducted bill: $10,000.00 less 15% is $8,500.00.
- Allocation factor: one half of 1.6 divided by 400 is 0.002; one half of 900 divided by 180,000 is 0.0025; together 0.004500.
- Full month (30 of 30 days): $8,500.00 times 0.0045 is $38.25, below the cap, so $38.25.
- If the resident was responsible for 12 of 30 days: $38.25 times 12 divided by 30 is $15.30.

## TX administration fee limit

For a TX community on an allocation program, when the household's water and sewer charges for the period come to $50.00, the billing administration fee may not exceed 9% of $50.00, which is $4.50.
